name: lexlint
description: A compliance lint for AI, scraping, and privacy law. LexLint's legal corpus spans AI, scraping, privacy, age-gating, and news-aggregation law; age-gating and news-aggregation are reference-only through get_law until run_lint can act on them too. Declare what your app does and where it operates, and get cited, jurisdiction-specific findings before you ship.
